header.title: How to Clean a Griddle
header.description: This guide provides a step-by-step process for thoroughly cleaning and re-seasoning a griddle, ensuring optimal cooking performance and longevity.

steps.description: Allow the griddle to cool slightly after cooking, but not completely, to prevent injury and ease cleaning.
Scrape the griddle surface to remove food and residue.
actions: Scrape the griddle with a spatula
Get most of the food and residue
Use a plastic scraper if the surface is non-stick
Use a more abrasive material for cast iron

steps.description: Scrub the griddle surface with a pumice brick to remove remaining food, ensuring to follow the grain.
Remove the tray from the griddle and clean it, potentially using a dishwasher or hand washing.
actions: Take off the tray from the griddle
Put the tray back into the griddle

steps.description: Wash the outer surface of the griddle with a mild detergent and warm water to remove food and oils.
actions: Mix mild detergent with warm water

steps.description: Thoroughly dry the griddle surface using a clean rag or paper towels.
Apply oil to the dry griddle surface to protect it and prepare it for future use.
